description: This Java class defines the TestOrder, a specific type of ServiceOrder used in the OpenMRS healthcare platform, with methods for copying, cloning for discontinuation, and revision of order instances.

classes.name: TestOrder
classes.description: A specialized order class for tests with additional attributes and behaviors specific to test ordering in the medical record system.

methods.name: TestOrder
methods.description: Default constructor for the TestOrder class.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates and returns a copy of this TestOrder instance.

methods.name: cloneForDiscontinuing
methods.description: Creates a new TestOrder instance suitable for discontinuing this order.

methods.name: cloneForRevision
methods.description: Creates a new TestOrder instance for revision purposes based on this order.
